title: Converbs II: the more, whenever, because
summary: Say **the more** and **whenever** with `-DIkçA` (*Okudukça seviyorum*), **when** with the person with `-DIğIndA` (*geldiğimde*), **because** with `-DIğI için`, **as soon as** with `-(I)r -mAz` (*Eve gelir gelmez uyudu*), and paint an action with a doubled `-(y)A` (*koşa koşa*).
canDo: Say what happens the more, or whenever, you do something
Say when something happened, and to whom: geldiğimde, geldiğinde
Give reasons, apologize and thank: Geç kaldığım için özür dilerim
Talk about feelings: worry, relief, embarrassment, happiness
vocabThemes: a new city and new neighbours
